user.title: Choose heating entities
user.description: Select the thermostat and entities used to plan home heating.

data.heating_activity_entity: Heating activity or demand (optional, binary or % sensor)
data.gas_previous_consumption_entity: Gas consumption from previous day (kWh, optional)

settings.title: Configure heating
settings.description: Choose the temperatures and warm-up limits used by the controller. Smart schedule settings provide a preview only. Comfort windows are day-by-day: each period must start before it ends and cannot cross midnight.

abort.already_configured: This thermostat is already controlled by another Central Heating Controller entry.
